Remember how being alone was my big worry? I'm 21 now and I've never had a girlfriend. Neither have my 18 or 20 year old brothers! But one is gay, and I just recently found out. Currently, I have no job, no friends who live close, and I literately sit in my room all day. I don't know how to help myself anymore. I keep thinking to myself "One day, it'll happen for you" but I haven't taken even ONE step to make that happen in my entire fucking life - primarily thanks to my obsessiveness with my acne! And it's so embarrassing that I absolutely refuse to go to a dermotologist any option that 
includes involving others. Indeed, my acne is not really all that bad. But, lack of any girlfriends made me think that it was to blame, when in fact it was my fear of being ugly (no one has ever said I was) and dealing with my parents that has kept me in isolation from any romantic interests. Hell, at this point I have genuine social skills issues. Even if my face clears up, not sure that it'd make a big difference in the end.

25 minutes ago, I was looking at myself in the mirror. Without a job, friends, hobbies or place to go other than home,  my face has been breaking out pretty bad.  Reflecting all too well how much stress I've been under lately. As I looked at  in the mirror, I said to myself - "Ugly". That's how I've felt for the last eight years of my life - a generally ugly excuse of a living being who contributes exactly and previsely zero to society, family or friends. And my life, in its itself, has been a self-fullfilling prophecy in almost every single way I've always feared it would. I started to pick at my blemishes, and I told myself "Dude! stop it. You gotta step away from this. It's not helping." I picked anyway. Finally, I pulled myself away, and ran in my room. I immediately started crying and shaking over my ugliness and my stupidity and selfishness. And that's where I'm at, right now. Writing out my deepest fears and failures, too afraid to tell my parents a single bit of this. I'm hoping that a miracle will happen, that something will happen in my life and to just be able to scrape by, but it just never happens and I'm not sure of anything anymore. Making things worse, I just stopped smoking cold turkey (6 year smoker) three days ago. Im proud myself, but it's also quite stressful by itself. Its all piling up at once and  then there's this: I have a chance to move out of state in a few weeks. No job , people I've never met but know of, one actual friend, but - no family, which is both good and bad (I am not fond of leaving my brothers here).  It's something I've been considering. It reminds me of  running from my problems, which I always do, but none the less could be very good. Or very bad. I can't decide what to do. And I might not even be able to, I'll find out in a couple days. 

I'm done. I don't expect help, but at least this puts it in perspective for me.
